recipes.title: Classic French Toast
recipes.description: Soft, golden slices of bread soaked in a cinnamon-vanilla egg mixture and pan-fried until tender.
steps: Whisk eggs, milk, vanilla, and cinnamon in a shallow bowl.
Heat butter in a skillet over medium heat.
Dip each bread slice into the egg mixture, coating both sides.
Cook 2–3 minutes per side until golden brown.
Serve warm with maple syrup.

recipes.title: Scrambled Eggs with Herbs
recipes.description: Fluffy scrambled eggs finished with fresh herbs.
steps: Whisk eggs, milk, salt, and pepper.
Melt butter in a non-stick pan over low heat.
Pour eggs in and stir gently until curds form and eggs are set but still soft.
Fold in herbs and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Overnight Oats with Berries
recipes.description: No-cook creamy oats soaked overnight and topped with fresh berries.
steps: Combine oats, milk, yogurt, chia, and honey in a jar.
Stir, cover, and refrigerate overnight.
Top with berries and serve chilled.

recipes.title: Avocado Toast with Poached Egg
recipes.description: Creamy mashed avocado on toast topped with a runny poached egg for richness.
steps: Toast the bread until crisp.
Mash avocado with lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
Spread avocado on toast and drizzle with olive oil.
Poach the egg to desired doneness and place on top.
Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Banana Pancakes
recipes.description: Naturally sweet pancakes made with banana and eggs for a quick breakfast.
steps: Mash bananas and mix with eggs and baking powder until combined.
Heat butter in a skillet over medium heat and pour batter to form pancakes.
Cook until bubbles form, flip, and cook until golden.
Serve with maple syrup.

recipes.title: Greek Yogurt Parfait
recipes.description: Layers of creamy yogurt, crunchy granola, and fresh fruit.
steps: Layer yogurt, berries, and granola in a glass.
Drizzle honey on top and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Oatmeal
recipes.description: Warm oats flavored with cinnamon and sweetened to taste.
steps: Combine oats, water, and milk in a saucepan and bring to a simmer.
Cook until thickened, stir in cinnamon and maple syrup, and serve.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Banana Toast
recipes.description: Toasted bread spread with peanut butter and topped with banana slices.
steps: Toast bread, spread with peanut butter, top with banana slices and chia seeds.

recipes.title: Veggie Omelet
recipes.description: Egg omelet filled with sautéed vegetables and folded to perfection.
steps: Sauté vegetables in butter until tender.
Beat eggs and pour into pan, cook until edges set.
Add vegetables to one half, fold omelet, and serve.

recipes.title: Classic Grilled Cheese
recipes.description: Golden toasted bread with melted cheese inside — a warm comfort classic.
steps: Butter the bread, place cheese between slices and grill until golden and cheese melts.
Slice and serve warm.

recipes.title: BLT Sandwich
recipes.description: Crispy bacon, fresh lettuce, and ripe tomato layered between toasted bread.
steps: Toast bread, spread mayo, layer bacon, lettuce, and tomato, then serve.

recipes.title: Turkey Club Sandwich
recipes.description: Triple-decker sandwich with turkey, bacon, tomato, and lettuce.
steps: Assemble layers with mayo, turkey, bacon, lettuce, and tomato; secure with toothpicks and slice.

recipes.title: Chicken Caesar Wrap
recipes.description: Portable wrap with grilled chicken, romaine lettuce, Caesar dressing, and Parmesan.
steps: Toss chicken with lettuce, dressing, and Parmesan.
Place filling in tortillas, roll tightly, and slice in half.

recipes.title: Tuna Salad Sandwich
recipes.description: Classic tuna salad mixed with mayo and celery served between bread slices.
steps: Mix tuna, mayo, celery, and mustard; season to taste.
Spread onto bread and serve.

recipes.title: Quinoa Chickpea Salad
recipes.description: Lemony quinoa salad with chickpeas and crisp vegetables — great warm or cold.
steps: Combine all ingredients, toss with olive oil and lemon juice, season and serve.

recipes.title: Caprese Salad
recipes.description: Simple Italian salad of tomatoes, fresh mozzarella, and basil with olive oil.
steps: Arrange tomato and mozzarella slices, tuck basil leaves between, drizzle with oil and balsamic, season and serve.

recipes.title: Greek Salad
recipes.description: Crisp salad with cucumber, tomato, red onion, olives, and feta cheese.
steps: Combine ingredients and toss with oil, vinegar, oregano, salt, and pepper; serve chilled.
